name: ready-for-approval
description: Indicates that the PR has been reviewed by Gemini and is ready for final approval.

name: needs-fixes
description: Indicates that the PR requires changes based on Gemini's review.

name: ci-failure
description: Indicates that one or more CI checks have failed.

name: review-failed
description: Indicates that the Gemini review process itself failed.

name: approved
description: The PR has been approved by a human reviewer.

name: changes-requested
description: Changes have been requested by a human reviewer.

name: scope:focused
description: PR touches a single architectural area.

name: scope:needs-review
description: PR touches multiple architectural areas and requires careful review.

name: bug
description: Something isn't working.

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation.

name: enhancement
description: New feature, request, or improvement to existing functionality.

name: chore
description: Internal maintenance, dependency updates, or minor changes.

name: refactor
description: Restructuring code without changing behavior.

name: ci
description: Continuous Integration configuration and scripts.

name: testing
description: Related to automated tests.

name: styling
description: Changes to styles, CSS, or UI presentation.

name: build-config
description: Changes to build configurations or dependencies.

name: automerge
description: Indicates that the PR should be automatically merged when all checks pass.

name: auto-code
description: Triggers automated coding agents (e.g., Gemini Coder).

name: needs-info
description: More information is needed from the author.

name: invalid
description: The issue or PR is invalid or doesn't follow guidelines.

name: wontfix
description: This will not be worked on.

name: duplicate
description: This is a duplicate of another issue or PR.

name: stale
description: No activity has been detected for a long time.

name: tech-debt
description: Issues related to technical debt or code quality improvements.

name: bot-generated
description: Issue generated automatically by a bot.

name: triage-needed
description: This issue needs to be reviewed and prioritized.

name: type-technical-debt
description: Technical debt that needs to be addressed.

name: type-frontend-improvement
description: Improvement to the user interface or user experience.

name: type-security
description: Security vulnerability or concern.

name: type-bug
description: A bug or unexpected behavior.

name: priority-high
description: High priority issue.

name: priority-medium
description: Medium priority issue.

name: priority-low
description: Low priority issue.
